'''Gactimus''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Triton/Legends|Triton]]. Several religious retreats were established there by the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Tritonite]]s.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|306|Gactimus}}</ref> All spacers stopping on the moon before continuing on their way via the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] were required to tithe away possessions to the religious idol [[Gactimus]] before leaving.

==Behind the scenes==
The name Gactimus was first created by [[Jason Fry]] and received mentions in ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' and ''[[Deader than a Triton Moon]]''; however, in both these sources, according to Fry, "Gactimus is a religious figure."<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/28148585|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2008-03-02|time=2:59 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802092323/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-51}}</ref> Following this, Gactimus was mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which described it as a moon, rather than an individual.<ref name="CSWE" />
